Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The agent asserted, without evidence, that Britannica gave an exact end-of-service date of May 30, 1848 and also misidentified Jefferson Davis’s rank in the Mexican-American War (calling him a lieutenant instead of a colonel). This fabricated specificity and misreading conflated the war’s treaty ratification date with Davis’s personal end of fighting; the task only required confirming the year 1848.
